```{r}
table(t.cells$xgboost)

df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$xgboost))
df.query <- subset(df, malig > 20 & non_malig >20)

rna <- as.data.frame(rownames(merge))
colnames(rna) <- "genes"
genes <- rna$genes
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJC]", genes, value = TRUE)

list <- rownames(df.query)
#list <- list[1:10]

df.pred.xgboost <- matrix(nrow = length(list), ncol = 5)

for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss.present <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == tmp & xgboost %in% c("malig", "non_malig"))
  
  ss.present$fivefold <- 1:5
  for(j in seq_along(1:5)){
    hold.out <- subset(ss.present, fivefold == j)
    train <- subset(ss.present, fivefold != j)

    label <- train$xgboost
    label <- label == "malig"
    label <- as.numeric(label)
    
    mat.in <- train@assays$SCT@data
    rownames(mat.in) <- rownames(train)  # Ensure row names are preserved
    keep.genes <- setdiff(rownames(train), tcr_genes)
    mat.in <- mat.in[keep.genes, , drop = FALSE]  # Preserve row names during subsetting

    mat.hold <- hold.out@assays$SCT@data
    rownames(mat.hold) <- rownames(hold.out)  # Ensure row names are preserved
    mat.hold <- mat.hold[keep.genes, , drop = FALSE]  # Preserve row names during subsetting
  
    bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(mat.in), label = label, max.depth = 6, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 100, early_stopping_rounds = 10, objective = "binary:logistic", colsample_bytree = 0.5)
    importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = bstSparse)
    importance_matrix$orig.ident <- tmp
    importance_matrix$round <- j
    
    avg <- as.data.frame(AverageExpression(train, assays = "SCT", group.by = "xgboost"))
    avg <- avg[importance_matrix$Feature, ]
    importance_matrix$larger.malig <- avg$SCT.malig > avg$SCT.non.malig
    
    pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = t(mat.hold))
    hold.out$pred.score.xgboost <- pred
    hold.out$pred.xgboost <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost >0.5
    
    predictions <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost
    names(predictions) <- hold.out$barcode
    
    right <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 1 & hold.out$xgboost == "malig")
    right2 <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 0 & hold.out$xgboost == "non_malig")
    total <- ncol(hold.out)
    correct <- (right + right2) / total *100
    df.pred.xgboost[i,j] <- correct
    
    if(i == 1 & j == 1){
      mat.all <- importance_matrix
      next()
    }
    
    mat.all <- rbind(mat.all, importance_matrix)
    } 
}

saveRDS(mat.all, file = "sct.importance.matrix.all.rds")
rownames(df.pred.xgboost) <- list
colnames(df.pred.xgboost) <- c("Round_1", "Round_2", "Round_3", "Round_4", "Round_5")
saveRDS(df.pred.xgboost, file = "sct.df.pred.xgboost.rds")
plot(rowSums(df.query[,c(1,3)]), rowSums(df.pred.xgboost))
```


```{r}
############################################################################
df.pred <- subset(df, malig > 20 & non_malig >20 & query >0)
list <- rownames(df.pred)

all.predictions <- numeric()
#table(subset$xgboost)
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  subset <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == tmp)
  ss.present <- subset(subset, xgboost %in% c("malig", "non_malig"))
  ss.missing <- subset(subset, xgboost == "query")
  label <- ss.present$xgboost
  label <- label == "malig"
  label <- as.numeric(label)
  mat.in <- ss.present@assays$SCT@data
  rownames(mat.in) <- rownames(ss.present)
  
  keep.genes <- setdiff(rownames(mat.in), tcr_genes)
  mat.in <- mat.in[keep.genes,]
    
  mat.missing <- as.matrix(ss.missing@assays$SCT@data)
  rownames(mat.missing) <- rownames(ss.missing)
  mat.missing <- mat.missing[keep.genes, , drop = F]
  
  bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(mat.in), label = label, max.depth = 6, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 300, early_stopping_rounds = 25, objective = "binary:logistic", colsample_bytree = 0.5)
  
  pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = t(mat.missing))
  names(pred) <- colnames(ss.missing)
    
  if(i == 1){
    all.predictions <- pred
    next()
  }
  all.predictions <- append(all.predictions, pred)
  
}
saveRDS(all.predictions, file = "sct.xgboost.all.predictions.rds")
```

```{r}
list <- rownames(df.query)
list <- list[1:10]

df.pred.xgboost.pca <- matrix(nrow = length(list), ncol = 5)

for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss.present <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == tmp & xgboost %in% c("malig", "non_malig"))
  
  ss.present <- FindVariableFeatures(ss.present)
  VariableFeatures(ss.present) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(ss.present), tcr_genes)
  ss.present <- ScaleData(ss.present)
  ss.present <- RunPCA(ss.present)
  #ss.present <- RunUMAP(ss.present, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
  
  ss.present$fivefold <- 1:5
  for(j in seq_along(1:5)){
    hold.out <- subset(ss.present, fivefold == j)
    train <- subset(ss.present, fivefold != j)

    label <- train$xgboost
    label <- label == "malig"
    label <- as.numeric(label)
    
    mat.in <- t(as.matrix(train@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings))

    mat.hold <- t(as.matrix(hold.out@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings))
  
    bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(mat.in), label = label, max.depth = 6, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 100, early_stopping_rounds = 10, objective = "binary:logistic", colsample_bytree = 0.5)
    
    pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = t(mat.hold))
    hold.out$pred.score.xgboost <- pred
    hold.out$pred.xgboost <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost >0.5
    
    predictions <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost
    names(predictions) <- hold.out$barcode
    
    right <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 1 & hold.out$xgboost == "malig")
    right2 <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 0 & hold.out$xgboost == "non_malig")
    total <- ncol(hold.out)
    correct <- (right + right2) / total *100
    df.pred.xgboost.pca[i,j] <- correct
    
    } 
}

rownames(df.pred.xgboost.pca) <- list
colnames(df.pred.xgboost.pca) <- c("Round_1", "Round_2", "Round_3", "Round_4", "Round_5")

saveRDS(df.pred.xgboost.pca, "final.df.pred.xgboost.pca.rds")
```

```{r}
# Global
ss.present <- subset(t.cells, new.clones %in% c("Non_malignant", "Malignant"))
table(ss.present$new.clones)
label <- ss.present$new.clones
label <- label == "Malignant"
label <- as.numeric(label)
mat.in <- ss.present@assays$RNA@layers$data
rownames(mat.in) <- rownames(ss.present)
  
keep.genes <- setdiff(rownames(mat.in), tcr_genes)
mat.in <- mat.in[keep.genes,]
    
bstSparse <- xgboost(data = t(mat.in), label = label, max.depth = 3, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 1000, early_stopping_rounds = 25, objective = "binary:logistic")
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = bstSparse)
avg <- as.data.frame(AverageExpression(ss.present, assays = "RNA", group.by = "new.clones"))
avg <- avg[importance_matrix$Feature, ]
importance_matrix$larger.malig <- avg$RNA.Malignant > avg$RNA.Non.malignant

p <- xgb.plot.tree(model = bstSparse, render = T, trees = 0, feature_names = bstSparse$feature_names)

png("xgboost.tree.png", height = 10000, width = 3000)

library(rsvg)
library(DiagrammeRsvg)
rsvg_png(charToRaw(export_svg(p)), "xgboost.tree.png")



importance_matrix$bin <- ifelse(importance_matrix$larger.malig == "TRUE", 1, -1)
importance_matrix$Gain_Scaled <- importance_matrix$Gain * importance_matrix$bin

top_15 <- importance_matrix %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Gain)) %>%
  head(15)
library(ggrepel)
ggplot(data = importance_matrix, aes(x = Gain_Scaled, y = Cover)) +
  geom_point() +  # Scatter plot
  geom_label_repel(data = top_15, aes(label = Feature), size = 3, max.overlaps = 10, nudge_y = 0.0005)
```

```{r}
t.cells <- subset(asdf, celltype %in% c("T_Cells", "Mitotic"))
df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(t.cells$orig.ident, t.cells$new.clones))
df.query <- subset(df, Malignant > 30 & Non_malignant > 30)

df.pred.xgboost <- matrix(nrow = nrow(df.query), ncol = 5)
list <- rownames(df.query)

s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

t.cells <- subset(asdf, celltype %in% c("T_Cells", "Mitotic"))
t.cells <- CellCycleScoring(t.cells, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = F)
t.cells$cc.score <- t.cells$S.Score - t.cells$G2M.Score

list <- list[1:10]
df.pred.xgboost <- matrix(nrow = 10, ncol = 5)
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == tmp & new.clones %in% c("Malignant", "Non_malignant"))
  ss <- FindVariableFeatures(ss, nfeatures = 1000)
  ss <- ScaleData(ss, vars.to.regress = c("nFeature_RNA", "percent.rb", "percent.mt", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
  ss <- RunPCA(ss)

  ss$fivefold <- 1:5
  for(j in seq_along(1:5)){
    hold.out <- subset(ss, fivefold == j)
    train <- subset(ss, fivefold != j)

    label <- train$new.clones
    label <- label == "Malignant"
    label <- as.numeric(label)
    
    mat.in <- train@reductions[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings
    rownames(mat.in) <- colnames(train)

    mat.hold <- hold.out@reductions[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings
    rownames(mat.hold) <- colnames(hold.out)
  
    bstSparse <- xgboost(data = mat.in, label = label, max.depth = 6, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 1000, early_stopping_rounds = 10, objective = "binary:logistic")
    importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = bstSparse)
    importance_matrix$orig.ident <- tmp
    importance_matrix$round <- j
    
    pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = mat.hold)
    hold.out$pred.score.xgboost <- pred
    hold.out$pred.xgboost <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost >0.5
    
    predictions <- hold.out$pred.score.xgboost
    names(predictions) <- hold.out$barcode
    
    right <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 1 & hold.out$new.clones == "Malignant")
    right2 <- sum(hold.out$pred.xgboost == 0 & hold.out$new.clones == "Non_malignant")
    total <- ncol(hold.out)
    correct <- (right + right2) / total *100
    df.pred.xgboost[i,j] <- correct
    
    if(i == 1 & j == 1){
      mat.all <- importance_matrix
      next()
    }
    
    mat.all <- rbind(mat.all, importance_matrix)
    } 
}

```

```{r}
df.pred <- subset(df.query, missing > 10)
list <- rownames(df.pred)

all.predictions <- numeric()
for(i in seq_along(list)){
  tmp <- list[i]
  ss <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == tmp)
  ss.present <- subset(ss, new.clones %in% c("Non_malignant", "Malignant"))
  ss.missing <- subset(ss, new.clones == "missing")
  label <- ss.present$new.clones
  label <- label == "Malignant"
  label <- as.numeric(label)

  
  mat.in <- ss.present@reductions[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings
  rownames(mat.in) <- colnames(ss.present)

  mat.hold <- ss.missing@reductions[["pca"]]@cell.embeddings
  rownames(mat.hold) <- colnames(ss.missing)
  
  bstSparse <- xgboost(data = mat.in, label = label, max.depth = 6, eta = 0.3, nthread = 30, nrounds = 1000, early_stopping_rounds = 25, objective = "binary:logistic")
  
  pred <- predict(object = bstSparse, newdata = mat.missing)
  names(pred) <- colnames(ss.missing)
    
  if(i == 1){
    all.predictions <- pred
    next()
  }
  all.predictions <- append(all.predictions, pred)
  
}
saveRDS(all.predictions, file = "xgboost.all.predictions.pca.rds")
saveRDS(df.pred.xgboost, file = "df.pred.xgboost.pca.rds")
```
